discover_ruling.question: stage 5 «Оазис» (bare noun) vs a fuller form with a Russian-only bar breakpoint (~1208px)
discover_ruling.reason: The source's content word (oasis = binding termbase «оазис») is kept; what is dropped is the menu call-to-action verb, and all three Russian titles drop their verb the same way under the one-form (noun) rule (Discover the oasis -> Оазис, Taste and shop -> Еда и покупки, Arrange your visit -> Ваш визит (final after round 2)). The verb marks no distinction the Arabic makes between groups, so the loss is stylistic, not referential: the five items under it say what the section holds. The fuller candidates cost more than they give: «Открытие оазиса» (+82px, min bar window ~1207) reads first as 'the opening of the oasis' (an inauguration event) in a menu that lists «События» inside it, an ambiguity the source does not have; «Знакомство с оазисом» is about +120px (~1245). Accuracy docked 1 point for the dropped verb.

judge_edits.reason: Blind reader: «Ваш визит» reads as a calque of 'Your visit' and does not describe its contents. «Посетителям» ('for visitors') is the native Russian section heading for practical visitor information on museum and tourism sites, a noun form like the other two titles, adds no fact, keeps the source's 'visit' domain, and moves further from the gold button «План поездки» (no planning lexeme, no «поездка» root). Menu-only key: no bar width impact. NEEDS a fresh blind-reader re-check of the phone-menu section (heading above «Где остановиться» · «Сохранённые места»), including whether it echoes «План поездки».

blind_disposition.obs: «Оазис» natural but very general; reads as a section 'about the place'; contents clarify it; optional «Что посмотреть»
blind_disposition.reason: «Что посмотреть» narrows the group to sightseeing (events, leisure and the map are not 'what to see'), drops the termbase word «оазис» the source carries, and switches to a question form against the one-form rule. The reader itself rates the issue minor and resolved by the items below. See discover_ruling.

blind_disposition.obs: heading «Оазис» on the phone matches the laptop button; fitting; not confused with the gold button
«покупки» ambiguous (malls vs buying produce); suggests «Еда и сувениры» or «Кухня и покупки»
blind_disposition.reason: «сувениры» adds meaning absent from en «shop» / ar «تسوّق» and mislabels online stores of food and goods; «Кухня» collides with the child item «Кухня Аль-Ахсы» directly below and narrows the group to cuisine (restaurants and fruit fall outside). The generality of «покупки» is the generality of the source verb; the reader notes the items resolve it.

blind_disposition.obs: «Ваш визит» unidiomatic, calque of 'Your visit'; does not reflect contents (stay + saved places); suggests «Планирование поездки», «Поездка», «Подготовка к поездке»
blind_disposition.ruling: applied in part (calque) / source flaw raised (contents)
blind_disposition.reason: Calque complaint applied: value changed to «Посетителям» (judge_edits). The reader's own suggestions rejected: each uses «поездка» and/or a planning noun, i.e. the meaning of the gold button «План поездки» that the brief forbids repeating; the reader concedes «Ваша поездка» would near-duplicate the button. That the heading does not name 'stay + saved places' is shared with the source and with all five language readers -> raised_to_owner, unscored.

blind_disposition.obs: «Ваш визит» overlaps the gold button in meaning (визит/поездка)
blind_disposition.ruling: source flaw raised to owner; mitigated in Russian
blind_disposition.reason: ar «رتّب زيارتك» beside «خطّط لرحلتك» carries the same overlap (cross-language pattern, five readers). The Russian edit removes the planning sense without adding meaning.

blind_disposition.obs: «Изменить» after the language name reads naturally but as two parts («Язык: Русский» + link «Изменить»); slightly bureaucratic; maybe «Сменить» / «Сменить язык»
blind_disposition.reason: The two-part reading is the actual layout (JUDGE-NOTES: name at one end, «Изменить ⌄» at the opposite end via margin-inline-start:auto); the single text line in 06-input was an artefact of the cut. «Изменить» beside a displayed current value is the standard Russian settings-row label; «Сменить» is a taste alternative, not an error; «Сменить язык» repeats «Язык» already on the row and breaks the one-word brief. Reader rates it acceptable.

raised_to_owner: nav.g.visit (source): ar «رتّب زيارتك» / en «Arrange your visit» sits beside the gold button «خطّط لرحلتك» / «Plan your trip» and does not describe its contents (stay + saved places); all five language readers flagged both points. Russian uses «Посетителям» to stay faithful and away from the button; a source-level rename is the owner's call. Unscored.

Out-of-batch Russian labels noted by the blind reader, for a future batch: «Плоды оазиса» unclear without context, «События» vs «Афиша», «Где остановиться» the only question-form item, «Карта» under «Оазис» on the phone but separate on the laptop, «План поездки» read as a menu item rather than a call to action. Logged only.

Round 2 (layout, not translation): the gold button «План поездки» directly after the third section can read as one of its items, and the language row has two tappable-looking parts («Язык: Русский» and «Сменить ⌄»); both are Header.astro design questions, same in every language.
Round 3: the reader suggests making the gold button a verb («Спланировать поездку») to separate it from the heading «Ваш визит»; nav.plan is outside this batch. Logged.
measure_after_judgment: No bar-visible value changed from stage 5 (discover/taste unchanged): expected extra bar width 0px; Russian min bar window stays 1125px <= 1181, no Russian-only breakpoint. «Посетителям» is menu-only (section heading in the collapsed menu and accessible name of the flat group in the bar).

dispositions.obs: «Изменить ⌄» alone does not say what is changed; as a separate control at the row end the reader may not link it to «Язык: Русский»; «Сменить» is more idiomatic for language; suggests «Сменить язык» / «Выбрать язык»
dispositions.reason: Second reader in two rounds (round 1 also proposed «Сменить»), now on the true two-control layout: a named defect. «Изменить» alone is the generic edit-a-field label; «Сменить» says swap the current selection for another, which is exactly what the control does (opens the language list), and it is the collocation Russian uses for a language. One word, ar «تغيير» / en «Change», no meaning added. Rejected: «Сменить язык» / «Выбрать язык» repeat «Язык» already on the same row and break the one-word brief; the objectless verb is how the source itself reads (en «Change» beside «Language: English»).
